{{Top|leg}}
"'''Poundies'''" was the nickname given by independent [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to the crews of the [[smelting ship]]s operated by the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] in the [[Mestra system/Legends|Mestra system]]. The poundies were a unique subculture within the [[Star system/Legends|system]]; they were hated by the miners as poundies were known to claim jump by using their ships to crush asteroids [[Claim marker|claimed]] by miners with only the barest warning.
